purpose: Profile definitions for materializing one pinned model/runtime configuration manifest per server launch.

cold_context_baseline.purpose: Measure native, non-reused context cost and decode behavior without cache or PFlash confounders.

primary_opencode_agent.purpose: Represent one primary coding agent with real tool definitions, changing observations, cache reuse, and long outputs.

server_policy.prefix_cache: enabled with an explicit measured budget
server_policy.pflash: off, auto, and always as separate evidence rows
server_policy.turboquant: none and k8v4 as separate retained-cache rows

long_context_research.purpose: Establish a PFlash and memory envelope for research/reference workloads without equating compressed context to native recall.

server_policy.pflash: off below fit boundary; auto and always above it
server_policy.turboquant: none unless retained-prefix policy is under test
